# Lydia and the Purple Cloth (Acts 16:15)

## Emotional Focus
Opening your home with kindness to new friends.

## Key KJV
“And when she was baptized… she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there.” (Acts 16:15)

## Gentle Retelling
Lydia sold beautiful purple cloth. After she believed in Jesus she opened her home to Paul and his friends and showed them kindness.

## Coloring Prompt
Lydia welcoming Paul and friends into her home with a warm smile.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Kindness makes room for others in your heart and home.”
